declaration_selection: run_batch.py and summarize_batch.py read this file when MQK_M1_BATCH_DECLARATION names it.

governance.historical_batch_01_stop_field: PREDECLARED_BATCH_01_CORRECTED.json carries no_batch_02=true. That field is HISTORICAL, governed that campaign's own stopping rule and is left unchanged.
governance.batch_02_authority: CURRENT_MISSION section -27 (Batch 02 NOT STARTED with the planned H1/H2/H3), the accepted Native Sizing V1 future-campaign decision, and the explicit operator authorization of controller V4-M1-NATIVE-HYPOTHESIS-BATCH-02-01.
governance.stress_sizing_operator_correction: The operator resolved the half-exposure stress as a recomputed 500 bps capital-fraction target quantity, not a post-sizing USD cap. An accidental UI selection of a USD 25,000 cap was voided by the operator and is not used.

protocol_note: A NEW hypothesis batch (not a reevaluation). Hypothesis != trial != attempt != evaluation slice != robustness scenario: three hypotheses, one trial per (hypothesis, symbol) = 15 trials, one disclosed selection population. The 500 bps half-exposure stress is a robustness evaluation of the SAME registered trial, never a trial.

calendar.definition: A session is one official US-equity regular exchange trading date. Weekends are not sessions. Full exchange holidays/closures are not sessions. Early-close / half-day sessions ARE sessions; their shortened hours do not alter their ordinal position within the month.
calendar.coverage_rule: Any date outside [coverage_start_date, coverage_end_date], and any next-session or month-end query that would need a date outside it, is a fail-closed refusal. Weekday arithmetic is never a fallback; a missing price row is never calendar evidence; row order of a data file is never calendar authority.
calendar.implementation_seam: mqk-integrity (shared lower-level crate with no workspace dependencies), consumed by mqk-strategy. NOT a strategy-local calendar and NOT the 2023-2028 intraday NyseWeekdays table.
authority_basis: NYSE published holiday schedule and observation rules (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars) for the regular holidays and the 2026 closures
NYSE special full-day closures within the covered range: 2018-12-05 (National Day of Mourning, President George H. W. Bush) and 2025-01-09 (National Day of Mourning, President Jimmy Carter)
Juneteenth is a NYSE holiday from 2022 onward (first observed 2022-06-20)
New Year's Day falling on a Saturday is NOT observed on the preceding Friday (e.g. 2022-01-01: 2021-12-31 was a session)
Cross-checks only, never authority: the fixed provider daily-bar dates for SPY/EFA/IEF/VNQ/GLD (identical session sets, no weekend rows) and the published NYSE annual session counts
calendar.early_close_sessions: are sessions and are not listed: they do not change which dates are sessions

content_identity.algorithm:
sha256 over the UTF-8 string: 'us_equity_regular_sessions_v1
coverage=2016-01-01..2026-12-31
' followed by one 'closure=YYYY-MM-DD' line per full_closure_dates_weekdays entry in ascending order, lines joined by '
' with no trailing newline
content_identity.binding: the content hash is bound into the H1 and H2 native semantic fingerprints; changing any closure, the coverage or the contract id changes both fingerprints and therefore every H1/H2 trial identity

bar_to_session_mapping.observed_bar_end_ts_semantics: an Alpaca 1Day research bar carries end_ts = 00:00:00 America/New_York of the session's civil date (04:00Z in EDT, 05:00Z in EST); verified on every row of the fixed dataset (13400/13400, zero non-midnight)
bar_to_session_mapping.S_of_t: the America/New_York civil date of the completed bar's end_ts; end_ts must be exactly 00:00:00 ET and that date must be a covered session, otherwise fail closed
bar_to_session_mapping.N_of_t: the first session date strictly after S(t); never derived from price rows

calendar.fail_closed_output: FLAT target (never a fabricated long) for an unresolvable S(t), an uncovered date or a missing calendar identity

hypotheses.economic_rationale: Return concentration around the canonical turn of the month may remain strong enough in the recent fixed ETF universe to survive conservative causal execution, costs, matched-capital benchmarking and the canonical promotion gates. Falsifiable; no profitability is assumed.
hypotheses.rule: For the latest completed bar t resolve S(t) and N(t). TARGET +1 iff is_last_session_of_month(N(t)) OR month_ordinal(N(t)) in {1,2,3}, where month_ordinal is the 1-based ordinal of N(t) among canonical regular sessions of N(t)'s calendar month and is_last_session_of_month is true iff no later canonical session exists in the same calendar month. Otherwise 0. Never negative.
hypotheses.causal_consequences: The completed bar before month-end targets long for the month-end session; the month-end bar targets long for ordinal 1; ordinal 1 -> ordinal 2; ordinal 2 -> ordinal 3 (long); the ordinal-3 bar targets flat for ordinal 4. Executed exposure = final session of the month + first three sessions of the next month, always via a strictly later bar (no same-bar fill).

special_cases.half_day: counts as one ordinary session ordinal

hypotheses.state: none: reconstructed from the latest completed bar's session identity and the calendar authority; a fresh instance equals a long-lived instance

hypotheses.economic_rationale: The canonical November-through-April seasonal regime may retain economic value in recent liquid ETF data under MQD's conservative causal execution, cost, matched-capital benchmark and promotion framework. No profitability is assumed.
hypotheses.rule: For the latest completed bar t resolve S(t) and N(t); M = calendar month number of N(t). TARGET +1 iff M in {11,12,1,2,3,4}; TARGET 0 iff M in {5,6,7,8,9,10}. Never negative.
hypotheses.causal_consequences: After the final October session N(t) is the first November session -> target +1 (entry on that session); December->January stays long; after the final April session N(t) is the first May session -> target 0 (flatten on that session). No same-bar fill.

special_cases.half_day: counts as a regular trading session/date

hypotheses.state: none: purely reconstructible from the latest completed-bar session and the canonical next session

hypotheses.economic_rationale: A strict new closing-price high relative to the immediately preceding 50 completed sessions may exhibit continuation over the next 10 signal sessions sufficient to survive MQD's conservative execution and costs. Modern out-of-sample evidence is hostile; this is a deliberate low-prior one-shot falsification.
hypotheses.rule: event(j) iff close_micros[j] > MAX(close_micros[j-50 .. j-1]) (strict i64 comparison; the current bar j is NOT part of the prior maximum; equality is no event). TARGET +1 iff at least one event exists at any of t, t-1, ..., t-9; otherwise 0. No mutable countdown; overlapping events extend exposure only through this rolling definition. Never negative.
hypotheses.exact_integer_form: event(j) iff close_micros[j] > max(close_micros[j-50..=j-1]); i64 comparison, no division, no floating point
hypotheses.required_history_derivation: the oldest event inspected at t is j = t-9 and needs closes j-50..j-1 = t-59..t-10; with the event bars through t the bounded reconstruction window is t-59..t = exactly 60 completed bars (59 insufficient; bars older than t-59 cannot affect the target)
hypotheses.state: stateless / restart-reconstructible: a pure function of the latest 60 completed bars
hypotheses.family_failure_rule: if this exact family fails, it is not reparameterized in this batch

universe.selection_rule: Fixed ex-ante five asset-class proxies (same list as every prior campaign): US equities, foreign developed equities, 10-year Treasuries, US real estate, commodities. IEF and GLD are kept deliberately as cross-asset falsification tests even where the calendar literature applies less directly.
universe.survivorship_note: A fixed list of long-lived, still-listed ETFs is not point-in-time clean. Each symbol is its own registered trial and the judge deflates over all five, so selection among them is accounted for; residual survivorship of the list itself is a stated limitation.
universe.population_note: Closed prior campaigns live in their own experiment ids and registries and are disclosed by name; scope = experiment_id.
universe.trial_order_rule: frozen: H1, H2, H3; within each, SPY, EFA, IEF, VNQ, GLD

experiment.population_policy: ONE experiment id holds the three hypotheses and all fifteen trials. The multiple-testing judge scope is the experiment id with hypothesis_id unset: ONE disclosed selection population. No per-hypothesis judge is used for selection; losing and failed trials are never excluded by hand.

fallback_if_corporate_action_gate_refuse.note: Boundary already established as corporate-action-safe by prior campaigns. Used only if the fail-closed gate refuses the primary window; declared now, before any result.

reuse_verified_data_from.rule: byte-identical reuse after verifying the provenance manifest artifact_sha256 and row_count against the CSV; no new provider call

partition.holdout_rule: last 6 calendar months of the dataset, reserved_not_evaluated, never consumed by this campaign
partition.warmup_note: The partition is carried over unchanged from the closed campaigns. The Rust emitter receives bars from 2016-01-04; the 252/253/204-bar warm-ups end during 2016-2017, so the early part of fold 1 is structurally flat for the affected engines.

quantity_semantics.executable_targets: 0 or exactly +1 share (every predeclared engine is fixed-one-share and long/flat)
quantity_semantics.rule: the economic engine holds EXACTLY the native absolute target quantity; ml_score is ignored; no weight re-sizing; a +1 desired / +N held mismatch is a fidelity failure

native_backtest.initial_cash_rule: USD 100,000 = economic_protocol.weight_to_share.equity_usd: Research, Backtest, scanner and Benchmark V2 share ONE capital basis; run_batch.py refuses any other value
native_backtest.bars: the same provenance-bound research bars converted deterministically, truncated at the holdout start

capital_sizing.cap_note: max_position_notional_usd 50000 is an INDEPENDENT safety cap (the same value as economic_protocol.weight_to_share.max_position_notional_usd). It is non-binding: the entry budget is USD 10,000 so a resolved quantity can never exceed it. It is NOT a half-exposure mechanism.
capital_sizing.quantity_rule: Q = floor(position_budget_micros / close_micros of the fully completed strategy bar on which a FLAT strategy emits its new +1 target); position_budget_micros = floor(initial_capital_micros * allocation_fraction_bps / 10000); whole Equity shares; refuse (stay flat) if the budget cannot buy one share; no +1 fallback; held exactly for the position lifetime; a genuine re-entry re-resolves from the same immutable capital.

benchmark.definition: passive buy-and-hold of the candidate's first resolved quantity Q, same initial capital, execution model and cost basis, through the existing accepted implementation
benchmark.historical_benchmark_v2_not_authorized: capital_matched_exact_target_buy_hold_v1 is NOT authorized for Batch 02; cross-substitution fails closed

stress_sizing.quantity_rule: resolve a new stress Q from the same causal completed-bar reference price; do not cap a 1000-bps baseline Q
stress_sizing.identity: the stress is an evaluation scenario of the SAME registered trial; the trial identity stays bound to the 1000 bps baseline; the scenario artifact separately binds the stress sizing, the stress signal stream hash and the execution-stress parameters

p7a_p7b_stress.stress_notional_cap_policy: stress_max_position_notional_usd and stress_max_target_qty are NOT used by this campaign. Neither a USD 5,000 hard cap on a 1000-bps quantity (the accepted exact-target replay refuses it) nor the historical USD 25,000 cap (non-binding here) is a half-exposure mechanism. The independent baseline notional safety cap (USD 50,000) is carried unchanged into the stress.
p7a_p7b_stress.source_note: Execution stress values (15 / 10 / 0.40) are the finite values prior campaigns froze before their results; the 500 bps stress is the mechanically derived half of the 1000 bps baseline and was not selected from any Batch 02 result. No other stress fraction is searched.

scanner_review.policy: mqk_backtest::StrategyScanReviewPolicy::default (min_bars 252, min_trades 5, min_return_pct 0, min_alpha_pct 0, max_drawdown_pct 25, min_profit_factor 1.05) -- unchanged; benchmark_policy = capital_fraction_matched_passive_buy_hold_v1
scanner_review.data: the same discovery-only converted bars (truncated at the holdout start), one registry/bars root per campaign run

promotion_policy.note: No canonical production threshold values exist in the deployed configuration. These are fixed now, before any result, and are supplied to the daemon only for the promotion transition.

rejection_gates: economic evaluation fails or is insolvent
judge not evaluable (DSR/PBO) or DSR below promotion_policy minimum or PBO above maximum
any required robustness scenario fails or is not evaluable (canonical P9 gauntlet, genuine shuffled placebo, P7A/P7B stress, DSR/PBO block-count sensitivity)
any promotion_policy threshold fails in canonical evaluate_promotion

execution_fidelity.metric: fraction of evaluated bars on which the simulator's discrete post-order position EQUALS the native desired target quantity (subject only to the canonical causal one-bar rule); positions only, never P&L; direction-only agreement is insufficient
execution_fidelity.enforced_by: mqk_research.ml.native_signal_registry_integration.native_exact_target_fidelity / NATIVE_EXECUTION_FIDELITY_FLOOR; an attempt below the floor is finalized failed and kept

review_and_promotion_freeze: promotion_policy thresholds, the baseline execution model rust_conservative_bar_range_v1, the P9 robustness scenarios and every scanner_review threshold are carried over unchanged; no observed result reopens any of them

holdout.rule: the last 6 calendar months of the dataset stay reserved_not_evaluated; scanner and backtest bars are truncated at the holdout start; a rerun requiring the holdout is a hard stop

comparison_scope.judge: canonical research_multiple_testing_judge_v1 over the whole experiment; DSR per trial, PBO over the batch; block counts 8/10/12

selection_authority.eligibility: a trial is eligible only if it clears every rejection gate in the canonical path
selection_authority.rule: among eligible trials select the single trial with the highest canonical judge DSR; ties broken by the lexicographically smallest canonical trial_id

family_outcomes.assigned_only_after: all 15 trials are accounted for and the batch-wide judge and canonical eligibility evaluation are complete
family_outcomes.FAMILY_SELECTED: the mechanically selected batch winner belongs to the family
family_outcomes.FAMILY_ELIGIBLE_NOT_SELECTED: one or more of the family's five trials clears every gate but another eligible trial wins the batch selection
family_outcomes.FAMILY_REJECTED: none of the family's five trials clears every gate after all final evidence is complete
family_outcomes.FAMILY_BLOCKED_NOT_FINAL: a genuine hard stop leaves required trials unresolved
family_outcomes.rule: a canonically final not_evaluable, blocked or economic-failure trial remains in its family; family rejection grants no permission to reparameterize

batch_outcomes.BATCH_REJECTED: all 15 finalized/accounted, one batch judge complete, zero trials clear every gate
batch_outcomes.BATCH_HAS_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE: at least one trial clears every gate; exactly one is selected mechanically; status PROMOTION_ELIGIBLE_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW; no production promotion state is written
batch_outcomes.BATCH_BLOCKED_NOT_FINAL: a genuine hard stop leaves required trials unresolved; never called rejected; no selection from an incomplete population

activity_report.rule: measured and reported; no threshold is created from these numbers.

batch_stopping_rule.infrastructure_failure: retry the same trial under a new attempt id; an economic failure is finalized failed and never retried
batch_stopping_rule.if_no_trial_clears_every_gate: record BATCH_REJECTED and stop; a further campaign requires a new explicit operator decision

attempt_identity_rules: A retry after an infrastructure failure is a new attempt of the SAME trial_id. trial_id derives from strategy_id, symbol, native inner and capital-fraction wrapped semantic fingerprints (H1/H2 including the calendar content identity), bars provenance, partition policy, economic protocol and the capital sizing block only; never from a result value.
forbidden_after_predeclaration: changing the H3 lookback, hold or event window
changing calendar semantics to increase results (a proven FACTUAL calendar defect voids prior results and changes identity)
changing the 1000 bps baseline sizing or the capital basis
changing the 500 bps stress fraction or substituting a USD cap for it
changing commission or slippage to improve outcomes
changing the benchmark or falling back to Benchmark V2
changing scanner, Promotion or robustness thresholds
trying another breakout horizon or seasonal window
